target.host_system: Platinum HM cut-in / field-move task system

records.useful: Design understanding only: pose -> show-mon -> action sequencing is already the structure Platinum uses; Emerald's indoor/outdoor banner variant selection is the one idea Platinum lacks.
records.why: Platinum already has a richer dedicated cut-in for every field move (including Fly bird and Fly landing, teleport spin-out and spin-in). Emerald's 2D BG-window streak banner would be a downgrade as a replacement and a redundant technique as an enhancement.
residual_ideas_not_promoted: map-type (indoor/outdoor) variant of the cut-in backdrop: no verified Platinum precedent, but value is a palette/backdrop swap only, below the promotion threshold
teleport/escape-rope accelerating upward spin: Platinum already spins out (StartWarpOutSpinning); acceleration profile unverified and not worth a record
constraints: no donor pixels (GBA 2D BG/OAM art does not match Platinum 3D cut-in)
records.confidence_note: Both sides source-verified; Platinum cut-in visuals not rendered or runtime-inspected, so the 'richer' judgement is structural, not visual.

evidence.summary: Each family is bound to a Hoenn-only location/mechanic (Lavaridge Gym, hot springs, desert sand piles, underwater seaweed, a single scripted legendary scene, Birth Island, Secret Bases). Platinum has no corresponding host for these mechanics (no Dive/Secret Base-style ground-effect hooks were identified; field move list in src/field_move_tasks.c has no Dive). Secret Base / Underground analogy was not investigated.
